summary: PR-5330 r9 Linux gate on vm2 at exact head 13522945de FAILS. Three deterministic defects. (1) Compile: :solr:core:compileJava fails at StreamingSolrClients.java:100 'incompatible types: ConcurrentUpdateBaseSolrClient cannot be converted to ErrorReportingConcurrentUpdateSolrClient' in two clean runs (focused leg seed 5330 and a determinism re-run). Root cause: PR commit 6476beb8debb narrowed the solrClients map/local/loop types to ErrorReportingConcurrentUpdateSolrClient while the non-generic base Builder.build() returns ConcurrentUpdateBaseSolrClient; upstream main keeps base types and compiles. (2) Fixture (visible only once the compile is fixed): under a minimal successor-style 4-line type fix, 9 of 10 focused tests pass but testRealRunnerCallbacksDoNotNeedClientMonitor fails deterministically with 'Unexpected request: PRI * HTTP/2.0' because the update-only client uses HTTP/2 by default (solr.http1 unset) while the raw ServerSocket + consumeHttpRequest expect an HTTP/1.1 POST line. (3) Formatting: the head test file SolrCmdDistributorTest.java (byte-identical to head, SHA cd66d928) is NOT spotless-clean — spotlessApply reformats 2 hunks during tidy, so :solr:core:spotlessCheck fails on the head-identical test. The r9 Windows report explicitly deferred compilation to Linux ('No Gradle, compilation or runtime tests on Windows. Linux must validate fixture framing and deterministic mutant failure'); this gate is the first compile of the branch. Verdict: failed — no clean verdict, and all three defects are material (compile blocks the positive legs; the HTTP/2 fixture defect is the exact raw-socket framing concern the gate calls out; the spotless violation breaks the tidy/check leg).
